ModMetaData.name: Ideology: Mercenary Creed
ModMetaData.author: wishRobber
ModMetaData.description:
A ready-made Ideology ideoligion for a mercenary company, wired into the Isekai guild bounty system.
Followers of the Mercenary creed live contract to contract. Completing an Isekai guild bounty raises the whole company's morale, scaled to the rank of the contract (a low-rank job is a small lift, a high-rank one a real boost), stacking up to a cap. That morale slowly bleeds away when the work dries up, so a company that keeps taking contracts stays sharp and content, while one sitting idle grows restless.
Pick "Mercenary Creed" from the Modded ideoligion group when starting a colony, or add the Mercenary meme when building your own.
Requires the Ideology DLC, Isekai RPG Leveling, and Harmony. A lightweight add-on, safe to add to a save; the ideoligion itself is chosen at colony creation like any other.
